boundary: preallocated float16 contiguous x and weight available -> real WrappedTorchNorm forward produces float16 y on the current CUDA stream
inside_timing: all CUDA work submitted by torch.nn.RMSNorm
allocation_policy: all primary input/module allocations predate timing
synchronization_policy: CUDA start/end events on current stream; end event synchronized before elapsed-time query
distributed_policy: single rank local boundary; no NCCL
future_ab_rule: reference and candidate must use the same preallocated tensors, fixture identity, timing events, current stream, and output policy
